verdict.rationale: Poke is itself an AI assistant that lives in Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, and RCS. Its docs describe delegating work through natural conversation: managing email, scheduling calendar events, setting reminders, acting across connected integrations, building and deploying websites, creating charts, and handing tasks like reservations and phone calls to real people. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
